$comment: MACHINE half of lens selection + posture; the HUMAN half is lenses.md. The lens files themselves (agents/lenses/*.md) are runtime-read prose, not schema.

lens.description: the code reviewer's lenses; `specs` is the specs reviewer's wiring lens and is never selected here

k8s-prod.const: changed ^charts?/templates/ or ^(argocd|k8s|manifests|deploy)/.*\.ya?ml$, or diff adds kind: Deployment|StatefulSet|DaemonSet|CronJob

lens_map.description: the claim's spec.lenses as `reviewer-optout.sh --lens-map <repo>` prints it; {} on a failed read (exit 1); empty output for a repo in no claim

attach_line.pattern: ^(→ lens attached: [a-z-]+ \((advisory — FU-101|BLOCKING — blocking)\)|WARN: lens [a-z-]+ fetch (FAILED — lens is BLOCKING|failed — review proceeds without it).*)$

posture_line.const: **POSTURE: blocking** — findings from this lens MAY determine the verdict.
